# Conditional continuous law and literal quantized output

PROOF gives an exact conductance draw. Its conditional field distribution is a
normalized Gaussian and must be paid, not treated as the already executed output.
The sibling quantized_field.py implements this completion using outward Arb.

For the rational positive-definite covariance C=L_x^(-1), an exact rational LDL
factorization gives C=T D T^T, with T unit lower triangular and D strictly positive.
Fresh independent Box--Muller pairs

    Z_1=sqrt(-2 log U) cos(2 pi V),
    Z_2=sqrt(-2 log U) sin(2 pi V)

give the required independent real normals. Each field component is T sqrt(D) Z.
The output is the componentwise floor on a SUPPLIED positive rational grid width.
It is the normalized full field law pushed through this quantizer, with the pinned
site omitted. It is not an exact finite string representing a continuous real.

Every U,V is a persistent lazy fair-bit interval. Increase its precision and use
outward elementary functions and arithmetic until every floor is unique. No
floating midpoint, accepted tolerance, Gaussian cutoff, or resampling of ambiguous
fields governs the result. The executable pseudorandom source is diagnostic only;
the probabilistic theorem assumes iid fair bits and correct outward operations.

For a fixed finite input, termination and finite expected requested precision can
be justified without assuming independent adaptive precisions. At depth p, exclude
U outside [2^(-p/3),1-2^(-p/3)] for ALL radial uniforms. This event has probability
O(nr 2^(-p/3)). On the complement the Box--Muller map has a deterministic derivative
bound growing at most O(poly(p) 2^(p/2)); input intervals of width 2^-p therefore
give exponentially shrinking field intervals, after charging the finite LDL norm.
Working precision can be enlarged to pay elementary rounding as well.

For each nonzero-variance marginal Gaussian X and fixed grid width delta, the
wrapped density sum sum_k f_X(k delta) is finite (and bounded, for example, by
1/delta+2 sup f_X). Therefore the probability that an output coordinate lies within
w of ANY grid boundary is at most O(w(1/delta+sup f_X)), with a harmless enlargement
of the constant for w<delta/4. Union over finitely many coordinates proves an
exponentially decaying unresolved-depth tail. This argument is unconditional over

# Result: exact centered harmonic-mixture equilibrium output

Completed private proof/implementation/controls. Independent whole review is pending.

The attempted capability was local thermal computation in a gapless anharmonic
medium without global equilibration. The result changes that question to a paid
FINITE global operation: normalized independent quantized full-field output for a
supplied centered, bounded-contrast Gaussian-mixture model, including nonconvex
edge potentials. No material potential, infinite background or mixing oracle is
granted. The intended infinite-volume local-cost capability is NOT_ACHIEVED.

For any finite connected graph, r components, conductance ratio q, and arbitrary
edge priors in(0,1), the new common-configuration current sum gives the sufficient
contraction

    c = r q(sqrt(q)-1)^2/8 <1.

It needs neither graph dimension/degree nor a lower bound on the height spectral
gap. Monotone CFTP then takes O(m log m)/(1-c) expected exact conditional queries.
The code pays dense rational inverse updates, not a free local resistance oracle.
The same theorem holds for a supplied rational spanning frame with PSD grounding.
The implementation specializes to graph incidences and constant prior.

After stiffness sampling, rational LDL plus persistent fair-bit Box--Muller/Arb
intervals return the WHOLE requested finite-grid field, with no float-governed
branch, cutoff or ambiguous-output replacement. Constructive scalar arithmetic
pays a finite mean bit-work theorem. The seeded executions are diagnostics;
installed-library expected CPU bit complexity is not certified.

The declared23.98-second batch includes full outputs up to63 coordinates,
nonconvex q4,p99/100 and three-component cases. Exact determinant/current/inverse
controls and a forced CFTP replay passed. The single Monte Carlo cycle statistic

occurred and no statistical result is a proof of the universal theorem.

# Model acquisition and useful boundaries

The source is a SUPPLIED rational centered Gaussian ridge-mixture model. It is
not a learned universal interatomic potential. A graph geometry and stiffness
ratio do not by themselves qualify this constitutive law for a real material.

The class can genuinely be nonconvex; PROOF and CONTROLS give negative curvature
at q2,p99/100 and q4,p99/100. But every edge potential is centered and monotone in
the squared increment. Arbitrary multistable, shifted, quartic-hardening or
Lennard--Jones interactions are not represented by the theorem.

There is a sharp simple reason not to transfer the representation to positive
quartic hardening. Set t=s^2. Any positive mixture g(t)=integral exp(-k t/2)rho(dk)
obeys (log g)''>=0, since it is a tilted variance of k/2. In contrast,
g(t)=exp(-a t-b t^2), b>0, has (log g)''=-2b<0. Even arbitrarily weak positive
quartic hardening therefore fails this positive Gaussian-scale-mixture interface.
No signed mixture was silently substituted.

The current theorem assumes no linear source and zero tilt. Adding a force h
introduces exp[(1/2)h^T L_x^(-1)h] into the conductance law. Its conditional
derivatives include means in addition to squared transfer currents. The present
all-graph influence bound does not pay those terms. Linear response at zero source
can be estimated from the acquired equilibrium law, but finite forced-law output
is not thereby acquired.

Finally, conditional edge probabilities require a GLOBAL effective resistance.
The code pays dense exact rational algebra. The initial aspiration of an infinite
gapless medium's local observable at volume-independent expected work is still
NOT_ACHIEVED. An entrywise Dobrushin supremum cannot simply be swapped with a sum.
The finite global coupling avoids that swap; it does not provide a local infinite
background oracle or a measured continuum/material truncation error.
